physicalNotes: No radius or mass of Black Eye Galaxy is recorded: it is an extended galaxy, and its package frames it at 8,007 pc (object.json worldFrame.bodyRadiusM), a presentation value.

sources.position: HyperLEDA (Makarov et al. 2014), NGC4826 = PGC 44182: centre, type SABa, D25 diameter 10.5 arcmin (http://atlas.obs-hp.fr/hyperleda/)
sources.distance: Tully et al. (2023), Cosmicflows-4, ApJ 944, 94; CDS J/ApJ/944/94, table 2 (distances of individual galaxies), PGC 44182: distance modulus 28.198 ± 0.03 mag (https://cdsarc.cds.unistra.fr/viz-bin/cat/J/ApJ/944/94)
sources.properMotion: Zero: the galaxy is held at its catalogued position; no motion across the sky is applied.
